description.fun: Rowlet is a round little barn owl with a leafy bow tie, soaking up sunlight by day so it can hunt at night. It glides in without a sound, then unleashes a flurry of kicks, and it can turn its head almost all the way round. It loves tight, dark spaces, so it'll happily nestle in its Trainer's bag or jacket. It was a first partner in both Alola and Hisui.
description.guide: Rowlet is a Grass- and Flying-type owl Pokémon and one of the first partner Pokémon of Alola in Sun and Moon, and of Hisui in Legends: Arceus. It stores energy by photosynthesis during the day, attacks silently with kicks and dagger-sharp feathers, and likes cosy, dark places. It evolves into Dartrix and then Decidueye.
description.tagline: A bow-tied owlet that naps in your bag

description.fun: Dartrix is a vain owl: it spends ages grooming its feathers and can even quit a battle to preen if they get messed up. It flings bladed quills with pinpoint aim and can bend them to curve their path, though it does miss sometimes, and when it makes a mistake it tries to cover it up, which only makes things worse. Help it through this awkward stage and it reaches its full strength.
description.guide: Dartrix is a Grass- and Flying-type Pokémon, the middle stage of Rowlet's line. It throws sharp blade quills with great accuracy and is notoriously fussy about its appearance. It evolves into Decidueye, or in Hisui into Hisuian Decidueye.
description.tagline: A vain, preening owl that hates a feather out of place

description.fun: Decidueye is a ghostly archer owl: it plucks an arrow quill from its wing, aims and fires in a tenth of a second, and can hit targets more than half a mile away. Pulling the vines on its leafy hood tightens it over its face to sharpen its focus. It's cool and calm, but panics if it's taken by surprise. Its look borrows from the pueo owl, a form of Hawaiian ancestral spirits, and from Robin Hood.
description.guide: Decidueye is a Grass- and Ghost-type Pokémon, the final form of Rowlet, based on an owl and an archer. It fires arrow quills from its wings with great speed and accuracy and can hide its presence from foes. Hisui has a Grass- and Fighting-type Hisuian Decidueye.
description.tagline: A hooded archer owl that never misses

description.fun: Toughened by Hisui's cold, it trades the hood for a red samurai archer's hat, grows thick legs and fights up close, kicking hard enough to fell trees before firing its hidden arrow quills. It's a fierce wanderer, modelled partly on the rōnin.

note.text: In Hisui, Dartrix evolves at level 36 instead of 34, and the region's harsh cold makes it sturdier: it becomes the Fighting-type Hisuian Decidueye rather than a Ghost type. It's the only regional form with a different evolution level from the original.
